policy.default_ingestion: Extract factual metadata and claim-level provenance; do not mirror mixed-rights documents by default.
policy.privacy: Suppress public coordinates for every named private property, generalize modern or precise unnamed private locations, and suppress personal locators.
policy.verification: Discovery sources create leads; they do not by themselves establish a verified case.
policy.cross_domain: Crop-circle and UFO events remain independent contextual records. Relationships must be labeled as source-explicit, deterministic candidates, or analyst-confirmed and never assert causality.
policy.raw_content: Retain fetched third-party pages only in a private content-addressed cache. Seed case JSONL files are restricted review artifacts because they retain internal custody fields. Only the public-safe Timeline GeoJSON is designed for public use; it labels source reports as reported_unreviewed and may contain source links, hashes, locators, and short factual extracts after privacy validation.

sources.name: MYTbrain UFO Timeline normalized corpus
sources.coverage: Global chronology; especially strong 1970s U.S. mutilation and mystery-helicopter material
sources.ingestion: Full normalized-event scan; classify direct cases separately from related and research-history events
sources.rights: Preserve original citations; do not assume source prose is republishable

sources.name: MYTbrain Crop Circle Atlas — UFO Timeline Export v1
sources.coverage: Global crop-circle context: 7,745 events, 8,391 source assertions, and 2,345 unique linked source URLs
sources.access: Pinned local export package with manifest and schema validation
sources.ingestion: Examine every event and assertion; search narrative values rather than field names or taxonomy glosses; preserve formation IDs and context-only trace role
sources.rights: Public tables provide metadata, source URLs, and hashes; do not treat linked prose or imagery as republishable

sources.name: Crop Circle Atlas combined formation catalog
sources.coverage: 309-page formation index and diagram catalog associated with the pinned Atlas export
sources.ingestion: Record page and slot provenance; use as an index rather than a complete narrative source
sources.rights: Metadata and source-locator use only unless a specific item permits broader reuse

sources.name: Crop Circle Atlas linked source-page discovery program
sources.coverage: All 2,345 unique source-record URLs referenced by 2,413 Atlas assertions
sources.access: Rate-limited live retrieval with archive fallback where permitted; deterministic per-URL disposition
sources.ingestion: Strip navigation and boilerplate, scan narrative content for animal-mutilation claims, and retain raw page bodies only in a private content-addressed cache
sources.rights: Honor the originating page and Atlas rights policies; public artifacts contain links, hashes, locators, access status, and short factual extracts only
sources.notes: Blocked, unavailable, and narrative-free pages are coverage gaps, never negative evidence

sources.name: FBI Vault — Animal Mutilation
sources.coverage: Primarily 1974–1978 correspondence and press material; federal jurisdiction was limited
sources.ingestion: Extract case leads, dates, places, agencies, document/page citations, and document relationships
sources.rights: Government-created records may be public domain; embedded third-party clippings require separate rights review
sources.notes: Do not treat every clipping assertion as an FBI finding

sources.name: Illume Umbra Cattle Mutilation Archive
sources.coverage: U.S., 1970s–present; state indexes, public-records releases, clippings, agency responses
sources.ingestion: Partner or request permission; ingest metadata/index first and link to documents
sources.rights: Mixed; some documents carry explicit fair-use notices

sources.name: Schmitt Conference Files (MSS 370)
sources.coverage: 1979 animal-mutilation conference, Operation Animal Mutilation, Southwest helicopter reports
sources.access: Digitized container-faithful PDFs through Illume Umbra; originating collection at UNM
sources.ingestion: Document-level index plus page/container citations; extract distinct incidents and agency correspondence
sources.rights: Mixed; rights notice must be honored
sources.notes: Includes transcript, papers, grant records, memoranda, reports, and correspondence

sources.name: Colorado Historic Newspapers Collection
sources.coverage: Colorado, 1859–2025, more than 8 million digitized pages
sources.ingestion: Search adapter or controlled query export; capture issue/page metadata and short factual extracts
sources.rights: Issue-specific; do not bulk republish copyrighted pages

sources.name: New Mexico State Library and NM Digital Newspapers
sources.coverage: New Mexico newspapers and microfilm from 1849 onward; digital coverage varies
sources.access: Public digital collections, databases, reference requests, and microfilm
sources.ingestion: Search and bibliographic extraction; request missing issues through library/reference channels
sources.notes: Critical for Dulce, Rio Arriba County, and Operation Animal Mutilation follow-up

sources.name: Historic Oregon Newspapers
sources.ingestion: Capture metadata and source citations; respect publisher participation and issue rights
sources.notes: High value for modern Oregon cattle-death waves

sources.name: Utah Digital Newspapers
sources.coverage: All 29 Utah counties; more than 6.3 million digitized pages
sources.notes: Useful for Uintah Basin and surrounding areas

sources.name: Library of Congress — Chronicling America via loc.gov API
sources.coverage: Historic U.S. newspapers; strongest before the main 1970s wave
sources.access: Keyless loc.gov API plus OCR and image services
sources.ingestion: Automated keyword/date/state discovery with page-level citation
sources.rights: Many items are public domain; verify item rights
sources.notes: Best for pre-1963 terminology and precursor incidents

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.coverage: Government reports, books, newsletters, periodicals, audio, and scans
sources.access: Advanced Search API, metadata, OCR/full-text search where available
sources.ingestion: Discover items, retain metadata, and ingest full text only when rights permit
sources.notes: Useful for bibliographic and public-domain report discovery

sources.name: GDELT
sources.coverage: Global news monitoring and historical event/news datasets
sources.ingestion: Use as a lead alert; resolve each lead to the publisher or official record

sources.name: Google Books API
sources.coverage: Books and periodicals with metadata and variable preview/full-view access
sources.access: API key or OAuth for public requests
sources.ingestion: Bibliographic discovery only unless full-view rights permit more
sources.notes: Locate indexes, page references, and source lineage

sources.name: Jacques Vallée Papers — Cattle mutilations (B13), Rice University
sources.coverage: Primarily U.S. 1970s–1980s reports, press documents, and research notes
sources.access: Restricted; Series I/II opens 2028 and case files later, per finding aid
sources.ingestion: Track as a future research source; contact repository for conditions
sources.notes: Do not plan the MVP around immediate access

sources.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats and bulk datasets
sources.coverage: Official livestock statistics by geography and time
sources.access: API, web query, and downloadable bulk files
sources.ingestion: Build county-year cattle head-year denominator and retain suppression/missing-value flags

sources.name: State and local public-records requests
sources.coverage: Sheriffs, state police, livestock boards, veterinary labs, agriculture agencies, AG/governor offices
sources.ingestion: Request incident indexes first, then selected full reports; log request, response, exemptions, and fees
sources.rights: Jurisdiction- and record-specific; publish only lawful redacted versions
sources.notes: Use seed catalog to create agency/date/county request batches
